description: CIF icon - same Ecuanutrition isotype shape (preserved via images.edit using Isotipo_Azul.png) but with the central serif letter E replaced by the three letters CIF in the same brand navy serif. Transparent background so the founder can drop it directly into email signatures, business cards, web. Drops to 16-32px without losing readability.
prompt:
A clean vector-style brand icon: take the official ECUANUTRITION isotype (the reference image — a stylized serif letter E embraced by two flowing curves forming a shrimp silhouette, with a small cyan eye dot above-right) and produce a derivative version where the central serif letter E is REPLACED by the three serif letters C-I-F rendered in exactly the same deep navy color and the same elegant serif typography style as the original E.

KEEP IDENTICAL TO THE REFERENCE:
- The two flowing curves around the central text (the shrimp body silhouette) — same shape, same navy hex 1E4670 color, same stroke weight, same overall composition.
- The small cyan eye dot floating above and to the right of the central text — same position, same size, same hex 7AAFD3 cyan color.
- The proportions of the surrounding artwork.

ONLY CHANGE: the central serif letter. Where the original isotype has a single tall serif E, now render the three serif letters C-I-F closely set together (slightly tighter tracking than normal) so they fit in the same horizontal space the E previously occupied. Same Bodoni/Didone-weight serif style with high stroke contrast. Same deep navy color hex 1E4670. The C is on the left, the I in the middle, the F on the right. All three letters are uppercase, all the same height, perfectly aligned at the baseline.

BACKGROUND: TRANSPARENT (alpha channel). NO white background, NO color fill, NO frame, NO border. Just the navy + cyan icon floating on transparency, ready to be dropped into any email signature or document at any size.

SIZE: square 1024x1024, with the icon centered, occupying about 80 percent of the frame width. Generous padding around the icon for safe-area when scaled.

STYLE: clean modern brand icon, crisp anti-aliased edges, ready for vectorization, premium minimalist aesthetic. Looks identical at 16x16 thumbnail and at 1024x1024 full size. NOT 3D, NOT photorealistic, NOT cartoon, NOT shaded — flat brand-icon style with the same finish as the official Ecuanutrition isotype.

REJECT: any element above or below the icon, the word CIF written above the icon as a label, any text other than the C-I-F inside, white background, color background, frame, border, drop shadow, glow, gradient on the navy curves, photographic textures, the letter E (must be replaced by C-I-F), four letters or two letters (must be exactly three: C, I, F), lowercase letters, sans-serif letters, calligraphic or handwritten letters, the word ECUANUTRITION written out anywhere, an envelope, a document, additional cyan dots, a circle around the icon, the word ICONO written out, watermarks, signatures.

description: CIF icon v2 FINE - same concept as v1 but with very delicate thin hairline strokes (matches the elegant icon-set aesthetic the founder shared as a ChatGPT mockup). Smaller leaf, smaller eye dot, smaller CIF text proportionally. Clean minimalist line-icon look for email signatures at 16-32 px.
prompt:
A clean THIN-LINE brand icon: take the official ECUANUTRITION isotype (the reference image — a stylized serif letter E embraced by two flowing curves forming a shrimp silhouette, with a small cyan eye dot above-right) and produce a DELICATE FINE-LINE derivative version where the central serif letter E is REPLACED by the three serif letters C-I-F.

CRITICAL DIFFERENCE FROM THE REFERENCE — STROKE WEIGHT:
- The two flowing curves around the central text must be rendered as VERY THIN HAIRLINE STROKES (about 25 percent of the original stroke thickness in the reference). Delicate, elegant, refined — NOT thick, NOT bold. Think of the difference between a felt-tip marker line and a ballpoint pen line: this version is the ballpoint pen line.
- The leaf flourish at the top must also be smaller and more graceful — about 80 percent of the size in the reference, with the same shape but lighter visual weight.
- The cyan eye dot must be smaller proportionally — about 60 percent of the original dot size.
- The CIF letters must be lighter weight and smaller (about 80 percent of the reference E's height) so they balance with the thin curves around them. Use a refined serif (Bodoni/Didone style) but in a regular or semibold weight, NOT a heavy black weight.

KEEP THE SAME:
- Same deep navy color hex 1E4670 for the curves, leaf, and CIF letters.
- Same cyan color hex 7AAFD3 for the eye dot.
- Same overall composition and proportions of the icon (the leaf is still on top, the curves still wrap around the text in the same way, the eye dot is still on the upper-right).
- The C is on the left, the I in the middle, the F on the right. All three letters are uppercase, all the same height, perfectly aligned at the baseline.

BACKGROUND: TRANSPARENT (alpha channel). NO white background, NO color fill, NO frame, NO border.

SIZE: square 1024x1024, with the icon centered, occupying about 75 percent of the frame width. Generous padding around the icon for safe-area when scaled.

STYLE: clean modern thin-line brand icon, hairline strokes, premium minimalist aesthetic, like a delicate icon from a Swiss banking app or a refined editorial publication. Looks identical at 16x16 thumbnail and at 1024x1024 full size. NOT 3D, NOT photorealistic, NOT cartoon, NOT shaded, NOT bold or heavy.

REJECT: thick strokes, bold strokes, heavy strokes (must be thin/hairline), any element above or below the icon, the word CIF written above the icon as a label, any text other than the C-I-F inside, white background, color background, frame, border, drop shadow, glow, gradient, photographic textures, the letter E (must be replaced by C-I-F), four letters or two letters (must be exactly three: C, I, F), lowercase letters, sans-serif letters, calligraphic or handwritten letters, the word ECUANUTRITION written out anywhere, an envelope, a document, additional cyan dots, a circle around the icon, watermarks, signatures, a chunky bold version of the original isotype.
